body:
OBSERVED 2026-08-09. USER-REPORTED — promote candidate, see bottom.

The same feature carries three different names depending on where the user looks:

- Classic UI: "Magic Shelves ✨" (`cps/templates/layout.html:672`), "Create Magic
  Shelf" (`layout.html:677`), "What are Magic Shelves?" (`magic_shelf_edit.html:337`),
  "Magic Shelves Order" / "Magic Shelves Visibility" (`user_edit.html:486,518`).
- New UI: "Smart shelves" (`frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx:280`), "Delete this
  smart shelf?" (`MagicShelfView.tsx`), and throughout whatsNew.ts.
- Backend/API/model: `MagicShelf` (`cps/ub.py`), route `/api/v1/magicshelf/<id>/…`,
  column `magic_shelf.kobo_sync`, setting `config_kobo_sync_magic_shelves`.

The concrete harm: a user looking at something the new UI calls a **Smart shelf**
must find and enable an admin setting labelled "Sync **Magic** Shelves to Kobo"
(`cps/templates/cwa_settings.html:795`) — which lives in the *other* UI. Nothing
on either screen states the two words mean the same thing.

This is not hypothetical. Discord user Aoife (2026-07-16), debugging why her smart
shelves would not sync to a Kobo Libra 2, asked directly:

  "Does it have anything to do with the mismatch in Magic and Smart shelf naming?
   Between the old and new UI?"

The naming was not her root cause (that was the missing per-shelf toggle, fixed in
v4.1.19 — see F-c78e8c), but it is why she could not confirm her own diagnosis and
ended up apologising for a correct bug report. This generates support load
indefinitely and it costs nothing to keep generating.

FIX: pick one user-facing term and use it in both UIs and the docs. "Smart shelf"
is the better choice — it is the term the industry uses (smart playlists/albums),
it describes the behaviour, and the new UI is becoming canonical. Keep the
internal identifiers (`magic_shelf`, the API route, the settings key) as they are;
renaming those is a migration with no user benefit. Scope is then: classic
template strings, the CWA-settings label, and the wiki — with both terms named
together for one release so existing users can follow.

CAUTION: these strings are translated. Renaming a msgid orphans every existing
translation (see memory: spa-strings-must-be-translated-for-fr-and-nl). Sequence
the msgid changes with a translation pass, don't land them bare.

PROMOTE CANDIDATE: Aoife raised this herself on Discord, so it meets the
"a person reported it" bar for the issue tracker. Held as a finding only to avoid
double-filing while CWNG NEW2 owns the reply to her thread. Promote with
`findings.py promote <id> <issue>` once they confirm.

resolution.note: promoted to #1498 (reported independently by a user)

title: One concept, three names: 'Magic Shelves' (classic) vs 'Smart shelves' (new UI) vs magic_shelf (API)
